source: Synthesized 2026-05-22 via Kokoro TTS on bigboy (unicorn-kokoro). Speaker A = af_bella (English female, ~15.2s), 0.5s silence gap, Speaker B = am_michael (English male, ~18.0s). Concatenated with ffmpeg, resampled to 16 kHz mono PCM.
speaker_a_transcript: Welcome everyone to todays test meeting. I am the first speaker, and I will be discussing the quarterly results from our diarization pipeline. We have seen consistent performance across all of the synthetic benchmarks that we have run this past month.
speaker_b_transcript: Thank you for that introduction. I am the second speaker, and I have a different perspective to share. The pipeline state degradation we observed last week was particularly concerning. We need a stronger probe to catch it earlier in the future, before it impacts real user sessions.
notes: TTS-synthesized speakers are easy mode for diarization (different vocal tracts, clean signal). That is exactly what a probe wants: a known-good input where any failure to return 2 speakers indicates pipeline degradation, not signal ambiguity. Real-meeting diarization quality is measured separately.
